title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Two Hundred thousand Pesos for Aid to the Provinces of Batangas, Tayabas, Laguna, and Cavite for the Repair or Reconstruction of Public Works Damaged By the Recent Typhoon

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated
the sum of two hundred thousand pesos as aid to the Provinces of Batangas, Tayabas, Laguna, and Cavite for
the repair or reconstruction of public works damaged by the typhoon of November six, nineteen hundred and
twenty-six, to be distributed by the Secretary of Commerce and Communications with the approval of the
Governor-General.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 19, 1926.
